_meta.disclaimer: Working comparison prepared for the board. Not legal advice. Every flag needs review by association counsel before it is relied on.

relationship_values.statute_controls: The statute sets a rule the documents cannot vary, or deems the rule part of the by-laws. Follow the statute.
relationship_values.statute_supplements: The documents are silent or thinner. The statute adds requirements on top.
relationship_values.document_controls: The statute defers to the documents. The recorded rule stands.
relationship_values.consistent: Document and statute say the same thing.
relationship_values.counsel_review: Unclear which governs, or enforceability is in doubt. Do not act without counsel.

flags.document_rule: No fewer than 5 and no more than 7 directors.
flags.statute_rule: Five is the default only when the by-laws are silent.

flags.document_rule: Directors serve until the next annual meeting.
flags.statute_rule: Terms expire at the annual meeting unless staggered. No more than 8 consecutive years, counting service from July 1, 2018.

flags.document_rule: Directors must be members or the voting representative of an entity member; a majority must be members.
flags.statute_rule: Adds bars: delinquent in assessments; certain felony convictions; co-owners of one unit may not serve together unless they own more than one unit or candidates are short.

flags.document_rule: None.
flags.statute_rule: Written certification plus a course of at least 4 hours, within 1 year before or 90 days after election; at least 1 hour of continuing education each year. Noncompliance suspends the director.

flags.document_rule: Members may remove elected directors without cause at any meeting.
flags.statute_rule: Recall with or without cause by a majority of all voting interests, at a meeting or by written agreement. 10% of voting interests may call the recall meeting.

flags.document_rule: Filled by the remaining directors.
flags.statute_rule: Same; the Board may hold an election instead.

flags.document_rule: Held within 10 days of the election; no further notice needed.
flags.statute_rule: Every Board meeting needs notice posted 48 continuous hours ahead with all agenda items.

flags.document_rule: 3 days' notice to directors; meetings open to members; notice posted 48 hours ahead.
flags.statute_rule: Posted 48 continuous hours ahead listing every agenda item. 14 days mailed and posted for a non-emergency special assessment or a rule on unit use. Owners may speak and record. No voting by email. Quarterly meetings for associations over 10 units.

flags.document_rule: Fixed by the members at the annual meeting.
flags.statute_rule: Officers serve without pay unless the by-laws provide otherwise.

flags.document_rule: Mailed 14 to 60 days ahead; posted 14 days ahead; affidavit.
flags.statute_rule: Annual meeting notice with agenda mailed, hand delivered or sent electronically at least 14 days ahead; posted 14 continuous days; affidavit filed.

flags.document_rule: Valid only for the meeting named; no one may hold more than five.
flags.statute_rule: No general proxies for owner votes. Limited proxies required to waive reserves and to amend the Declaration, Articles or By-Laws. No proxies in Board elections. A proxy expires 90 days after the first meeting it was given for.

flags.document_rule: Elected by members at the annual meeting; one vote per unit per vacancy; non-cumulative. By-Law 3.1 speaks of 'electing officers'.
flags.statute_rule: Written ballot or voting machine; no proxies. First notice at least 60 days before; candidate notice of intent at least 40 days before; second notice with ballot 14 to 34 days before. Plurality wins. At least 20% of eligible voters must cast a ballot.

flags.document_rule: President calls; must call on written request of members holding 50% or more of the votes.
flags.statute_rule: No general rule. For a recall, 10% of voting interests may call the meeting.

flags.document_rule: Majority of the votes.
flags.statute_rule: Majority unless the by-laws set a lower number.

flags.document_rule: Proposed by November 1; mailed 30 days before the Board meeting.
flags.statute_rule: Notice and a copy of the proposed budget at least 14 days before the meeting; adopted at least 14 days before the fiscal year starts.

flags.document_rule: 10% of members may demand a special meeting; a majority of all votes may revise the budget or recall the Board.
flags.statute_rule: The Board must itself propose a substitute budget without discretionary spending; owners may adopt it by a majority of all voting interests. Reserves, non-recurring items and insurance premiums are excluded from the test.
flags.note: How the By-Law petition right sits with the statutory substitute budget.

flags.document_rule: No requirement to establish or fund reserves.
flags.statute_rule: Reserves required for roof, painting and paving and for any item over $25,000. Waiver by a majority of all voting interests. Buildings of three habitable stories or more need a structural integrity reserve study and may not waive reserves for those items.
flags.note: Counsel or engineer to confirm whether the building is three habitable stories.

flags.document_rule: Set by December 15; twelve monthly payments due on the 1st.
flags.statute_rule: At least quarterly.

flags.document_rule: By each unit's Exhibit B percentage. The Prospectus (VI) and budget exhibit say equal per apartment.
flags.statute_rule: Changing a unit's share needs that owner, lienholders and all other owners unless the original declaration says otherwise.
flags.note: Recorded documents conflict with each other: percentages vs equal shares.

flags.document_rule: Late charge set by the directors after 10 days; Board may accelerate.
flags.statute_rule: 18% interest when the declaration names no rate. Late fee capped at the greater of $25 or 5% of the installment. Payments apply to interest, late fee, costs and fees, then the assessment.

flags.document_rule: Lien from recording a claim; secures attorney's fees; foreclosed like a mortgage.
flags.statute_rule: Claim of lien lapses after 1 year unless suit is filed. No foreclosure judgment until 45 days after written notice of intent.

flags.document_rule: First mortgagee owes nothing for assessments due before it took title.
flags.statute_rule: Liable for the lesser of 12 months of assessments or 1% of the original mortgage debt, for mortgages recorded on or after April 1, 1992.

flags.document_rule: Dade County banks designated by the directors; withdrawals only by checks signed by authorized persons.
flags.statute_rule: All funds held separately in the association's name. No commingling with a manager's or another association's funds. No association debit cards.

flags.document_rule: May be required by the directors.
flags.statute_rule: Mandatory. Covers everyone who signs checks plus the president, secretary and treasurer, for the most funds held at any one time.

flags.document_rule: Open to members at reasonable times; written summary annually; attorney's fees if inspection is refused.
flags.statute_rule: Available within 10 working days of a written request; $50 a day minimum damages up to 10 days. Most records kept 7 years; core documents permanently.

flags.document_rule: None.
flags.statute_rule: A condominium of 25 or more units must post governing documents, rules, minutes, contracts, budget, financial report and meeting notices on a website or app.
flags.note: 28 units. HOA Connect can be that website.

flags.document_rule: Written summaries annually.
flags.statute_rule: Prepared within 90 days of year end; delivered within 21 days of completion and no later than 180 days after year end. Level set by revenue: under $150,000 cash report; $150,000-$300,000 compiled; $300,000-$500,000 reviewed; $500,000+ audited.

flags.document_rule: 1978 bans all leasing. 1994 sets rental rules and does not mention the ban.
$100 fee paid by the unit owner.
flags.statute_rule: Transfer fee capped at $150 per applicant.

flags.document_rule: Owner posts $200 plus six months' maintenance in advance; may be commingled; no interest.
flags.statute_rule: A security deposit may be required of the lessee, up to one month's rent, held in escrow. Association funds may not be commingled.

flags.document_rule: Tenant approved like a purchaser.
flags.statute_rule: Owner's delinquency is a permitted ground for refusal.

flags.document_rule: Declaration amended by owners of 75% of the units.
flags.statute_rule: A new amendment that prohibits rentals, changes the rental term or limits how often owners may rent binds only consenting owners and owners who take title afterward.

flags.document_rule: No children under 18 as permanent household members.
flags.statute_rule: Familial-status discrimination is barred unless the community qualifies as housing for older persons: 80% of occupied units with a resident 55 or older, published policies, registration with the Florida Commission on Human Relations.

flags.document_rule: Decl. 11.1 allows ordinary pets. The 1978 rewrite of Section 11 does not say whether 11.1 survives.
Directors may adopt reasonable regulations. Remedies are damages, injunction and attorney's fees; no fines.
flags.statute_rule: Fines up to $100 per violation, $1,000 total, after 14 days' notice and a hearing before an independent committee of at least three owners. Rule changes on unit use need 14 days' mailed and posted notice.

flags.document_rule: One space per unit; no guest or second-car spaces.
flags.statute_rule: An owner may not be barred from installing an EV charger in the owner's exclusively designated parking space, at the owner's cost.

flags.document_rule: Written approval of owners of three-fourths of all units, plus the largest mortgagee.
flags.statute_rule: The declaration's procedure controls; 75% applies only when it is silent.

flags.document_rule: No changes to exterior walls, windows, doors, balconies or structure without written approval of three-fourths of the units.
flags.statute_rule: The Board must adopt hurricane protection specifications and may not refuse an installation that meets them.

flags.document_rule: Irrevocable right of access at reasonable hours.
flags.statute_rule: Same; adds a right to enter abandoned units.

flags.document_rule: Association insures at maximum insurable replacement value; proceeds to an Insurance Trustee (Dade Federal Savings and Loan Association of Miami); lender approvals.
flags.statute_rule: Adequate property insurance with replacement cost determined at least every 3 years. Owners responsible for floor, wall and ceiling coverings, fixtures, appliances, water heaters, cabinets and personal property.

flags.document_rule: Owners of 75% of the units; effective on recording; no discrimination or share change without consent.
flags.statute_rule: The declaration's method controls. Proposals must show full text with additions underlined and deletions struck through. Effective on recording.

flags.document_rule: By-Law 9: only as set forth in the Articles. Art. 13: majority vote of the membership. Art. 15: 21 units to amend the Articles.
flags.statute_rule: The by-laws' own method controls; two-thirds applies only if they give none. Full-text format. Amendments must be recorded.

flags.topic: Reach of later statute changes (Kaufman language)
flags.document_rule: Adopts 'Chapter 711 of the Florida Statutes' with no 'as amended from time to time'.
flags.statute_ref: Tropicana Condo. Ass'n v. Tropical Condo., LLC (Fla. 3d DCA 2016)
flags.statute_rule: Without that phrase, a later change to the Act does not apply to an existing declaration when it would impair owners' contract rights.
flags.note: Organization-level flag. Affects every substantive conflict.
